title: CorruptedSmpPlugin
description: A high-performance Corruption SMP system for Paper 1.21.1+. Track souls, gain corruption on death, and craft custom dark artifacts!
body:
# ⚡ CorruptedSMP | The Ultimate Dark Progression System ⚡

Welcome to **CorruptedSMP**, a next-generation, high-performance corruption mechanics plugin designed exclusively for modern Minecraft server environments. Give your players a reason to fear death and push their souls to the limit with custom crafting and tracking profiles.

Built from the ground up for **Paper 1.21.1 and 1.21.11**, this plugin utilizes cutting-edge optimization techniques to ensure zero server thread lag and zero impact on your MSPT.

---

## 🔮 Core Features

* 🧬 **Real-time Corruption Tracking:** Every player profile tracks their soul's corruption status seamlessly.
* 💀 **Death-Driven Progression:** Dying isn't just about losing gear anymore. Every death allows dark energy to seep into your soul, increasing your corruption score by **+5 points** instantly!
* 🛠️ **Custom Crafting Component:** Introduces a brand-new custom artifact—the **Heart of Corruption**.
* 💎 **Vanilla Friendly:** Seamless integration with vanilla items via modern namespaces.
* ⚡ **Performance Optimized:** Uses advanced local caching structures to ensure your main server thread never hangs.
* 🛡️ **Modern Text Engine:** Fully built using the native Adventure API for crisp, modern text delivery in chat and item displays.

---

## 🔨 Custom Crafting Recipe

To track or manipulate energy, players can craft the legendary **Heart of Corruption** using high-tier materials on a standard crafting table.

### **Recipe Layout:**
* 🟥 **D** = Diamond
* ⬛ **O** = Crying Obsidian
* 🔮 **E** = Ender Eye

```text
[ D ] [ O ] [ D ]
[ O ] [ E ] [ O ]
[ D ] [ O ] [ D ]
```

---

## 💻 Player Commands

Players can access their profiles directly in-game using the central base command:
* `/corruption` — Displays your current real-time corruption percentage tier directly in chat with custom color indicators.

---

## ⚙️ Administration & Commands

Manage your server's corruption balance easily with built-in admin sub-commands.

### **Commands:**
* `/corruption help` - Shows the help menu in-game.
* `/corruption info` - Check your own current corruption points.
* `/corruption give [player] [amount]` - Add corruption points to a specific player.
* `/corruption take [player] [amount]` - Take away corruption points from a player.
* `/corruption set [player] [amount]` - Set a player's corruption points to an exact number.
* `/corruption reload` - Reloads the plugin settings safely.

### **Permissions:**
* `corruptedsmp.use` - Allows players to use the basic `/corruption` commands. (Default: True)
* `corruptedsmp.admin` - Allows operators to modify data profiles and reload the plugin. (Default: OP)

---

## ⚙️ Installation & Requirements

1. Drop the `CorruptedSMP-1.0.0.jar` file into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Ensure your server is running **Paper 1.21.1 or 1.21.11**.
3. Requires **Java 21** or higher.
4. Restart your server and enjoy the dark progression!
